title: Can quinoa rival chicken protein?

scenes.text: Why does 1 cup of quinoa pack 8 g of protein?
One cup of cooked quinoa provides about 8 grams of protein.
A 3‑ounce (85 g) chicken breast delivers roughly 25 grams of protein.
When you compare protein per calorie, beans and lentils match chicken, and quinoa is close too.
